children: TVS Holdings in a stock exchange filing on Wednesday informed the exchanges that its promoters VS Trust and Srinivasan Trust have pledged shares representing 8.28 per cent of TVS Holdings’ total equity capital as collateral for loans on October 28.
These loans are raised to acquire shares of a group company and meet transaction-related expenses, the company added.

A total of ₹825 crore was raised in credit facilities from JM Financial Products Limited and JM Financial Credit Solutions Ltd. Of the total borrowing, VS Trust has availed credit of ₹265 crore from JM Financial Products Ltd, against which it has pledged 13,40,600 shares, representing 6.63 per cent of THL’s equity capital.

Similarly, Srinivasan Trust has raised ₹560 crore from JM Financial Credit Solutions Ltd through two facilities of ₹165 crore and ₹395 crore, with 3,35,200 shares (equivalent to 1.66 per cent of equity) offered as collateral.

Following the fresh pledge, the total number of encumbered shares held by the promoters in TVS Holdings will increase to 43,37,200 shares, representing 21.44 per cent of the company’s total equity capital.
The disclosure identifies Venu Srinivasan as the trustee of VS Trust, while VS Trustee Private Ltd is the trustee of Srinivasan Trust.

While the filing does not specify the group company whose shares are proposed to be acquired, businessline reported earlier that TSF Investments Ltd (formerly Sundaram Finance Holdings Ltd), on October 28, sold 7,55,682 shares of TVS Holdings Ltd and as per BSE bulk deal data, TSF Investments sold 7,55,682 shares at ₹10,905 each. The buyers were VS Trust (2.43 lakh shares) and Srinivasan Trust (5.13 lakh shares).

title: Two trusts part of TVS Holdings promoter group pledge shares to fund stake buy
